These removals are not required by pressing a switch. Instruction: Instead of showing the existing switch closed, the edit removes it and leaves an isolated battery and unlit bulb, so the requested action is absent. Knowledge: The explanation requires two illuminated bulbs; only one unlit bulb remains. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Instruction: The exposed flesh remains pale and fresh-looking without a visible aging change; reconstructing the fruit does not depict it after time has passed.
